lemmas.statement: The Tao matrix S6 has unit-modulus entries and S6 S6* = 6I, as a conjunction of the two existing theorems.

near_misses.claim: Every entry of taoMatrix lies in {1, w, w^2} with w = tao_omega.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The entry-set identity is not among the cited existing declarations; only unit modulus is grounded, so it is not asserted.

near_misses.claim: S6 is isolated and the CHM(6) moduli space is disconnected.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: These are cited literature facts listed as BOTTLENECK, not formalized in any cited declaration.

open_obligations: Formalize that every entry of taoMatrix lies in {1, w, w^2} with w = tao_omega (no existing declaration cited for this).
Formalize isolation of S6 and disconnectedness of the CHM(6) moduli space (literature facts, not in @SRC).
Lemma l_tao_entries_unit_and_unitary is a conjunction of existing theorems; its lean_skeleton is left empty and it is not claimed proved since no single declaration is cited for the conjunction.
